sn35.14:1.1: me bhikkhave sambodhā anabhisambuddhassa bodhisattasseva sato etad ahosi || ||
sn35.14:1.2: Ko nu kho rūpānam assādo || ko ādīnavo || kiṃ nissaraṇaṃ ||
sn35.14:1.7: Ko dhammānam assādo || ko ādīnavo || kim nissaraṇanti || || 3
sn35.14:1.9: Yaṃ kho rūpe paṭicca uppajjati sukhaṃ somanassam || ayaṃ rupānam assādo || ||
sn35.14:1.10: Yaṃ rūpā aniccā dukkhā vipariṇāmadhammā || ayaṃ dhammānam ādīnavo || ||
sn35.14:1.11: Yo rūpesu chandarāgavinayo chandarāgapahānaṃ idam rūpānaṃ nissaraṇaṃ || || 4-7
sn35.14:1.16: Dhamme paṭicca uppajjati sukhaṃ somanassaṃ ayam assādo || ||
sn35.14:1.17: Yaṃ dhammānam aniccā dukkhā vipariṇāmaddhammā || ayaṃ dhammānam ādīnavo ||
sn35.14:1.18: Yo dhammesu chandarāgavinayo chandarāgapahānaṃ || idam dhammānaṃ nissaraṇaṃ || || 9-10
sn35.14:2.1: Yāva kīvañcāham bhikkhave imesaṃ channam bāhirānam āyatanānam evam assādaṃ ca assādato ādīnavaṃ ca ādīnavato nissaraṇaṃ ca nissaraṇato yathābhūtaṃ nābbhaññāsiṃ || pe ||
sn35.14:2.4: Akuppā me cetovimutti ayam antimā jāti natthidāni punabbhavoti || || 2
